fullPassage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly — what I thought was a ridiculous pace. Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life. And, being the rookie, I wanted to prove myself to the group. Why not show off my superior conditioning? So up front I went. Then, as we approached 16,000 feet, I suddenly began to feel dizzy. Not long after, I was staggering. The group had to take my pack. In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing assistance just to walk. On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a burden to the group. I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard.

questions.passage: After a few nights, we ventured out on a hike to 16,000 feet. The group members were all experienced, so I couldn't understand why they were climbing so slowly — what I thought was a ridiculous pace. Having trained hard for this, I was in the best shape of my life. And, being the rookie, I wanted to prove myself to the group. Why not show off my superior conditioning? So up front I went. Then, as we approached 16,000 feet, I suddenly began to feel dizzy. Not long after, I was staggering. The group had to take my pack. In a matter of minutes, I became a basket case, needing assistance just to walk. On the way down to the hut, I could barely keep in a straight line because of the nausea, headache, and dizziness. Now all I felt was guilt for becoming a burden to the group. __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: I was glad I had shown my strength
I felt proud of my accomplishment
I wanted to try again immediately

det.korean: 무리하지 않았더라면 좋았을 텐데(I wished I hadn't pushed myself so hard). 동의 표현.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 과도하게 힘을 쓴 것을 후회: wished + hadn't pushed의 동의 표현
❌ ① 힘을 보여줘서 기쁘다: 죄책감과 모순
❌ ③ 성취감: 실패한 상황
❌ ④ 즉시 재시도: 아픈 상황
det.tip: I wished I hadn't pushed myself = I regretted having overexerted myself

ch: I was eager to demonstrate my abilities to the team
